parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ReportStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the compliance check feature. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.description: The name of the protected object group to which the protected object belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: The name of the protected object.

parameters.name: TraceStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the tracing and auditing feature. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-module-status --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqtm00 --resources cwaf-000-waf --report-status 1 --trace-status 1 --resource-groups group1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
